definition: In this workplace psychology context, a union is an employee organization whose participation and support climate forms part of the work environment. When employees perceive stronger union support, it is associated with greater psychological safety and can strengthen links between resilience and creative behaviour.

reasons: The packet does not define a union as an employee organization; it only refers to union participation/support climate or atmosphere in the workplace.
The claim that stronger union support is associated with greater psychological safety is presented as an implication in the article, not as a general definitional property of the term.

The statement that union support can strengthen links between resilience and creative behaviour overstates the study result; the packet reports moderation of the indirect effect of success goal orientation on creativity via psychological resilience, not a general resilience–creativity link.
The packet uses the terms “trade union” / “union participation atmosphere/support climate,” but it does not explicitly define a “union” as “an employee organization.”
